content: Replace the repository's implicit any-active-session scheduling and commit authority with one decision-authorized execution-focus contract. Make the default focus resolve to one active work item and one incomplete Exit Gate on a dependency-valid path; require every durable candidate commit to include its own in-progress owning session rather than borrowing an unrelated active session; keep closing records and explicitly governed migration/maintenance work bounded. Add validator, hook, self-test, documentation, current-progress, and active-session handoff coverage through D0029 and SC0006 without rewriting factual historical evidence.
